scope: Three source root causes. Generated artifacts, suppression/configuration, dependencies and unrelated changes left alone.

rootCauses.name: Shopify context identity
rootCauses.impact: Unrelated parent renders recreated the context value and woke memoized consumers. A failing regression reproduced identity changes and unnecessary consumer rendering. This is avoidable rendering work, not a claimed checkout failure.
rootCauses.fix: Memoize action callbacks with actual state/config dependencies and memoize the complete context value. Preserve analytics, cart state, checkout link navigation and current action semantics.
rootCauses.tests: Context identity/consumer-render regression now passes. Variant selection, add-to-cart, quantity updates and checkout after changed configuration use current state and credentials. Existing checkout recovery tests pass.

rootCauses.name: Product carousel responsive image sizes
rootCauses.impact: The browser previously assumed full-viewport width for images that normally occupy half the desktop grid. Can download unnecessarily large sources; no live bandwidth or LCP measurement claimed.
rootCauses.fix: Use the actual theme sm breakpoint and configured numeric first-column share; default 6/12 becomes 50vw. Mobile uses 100vw. Flexible/unknown widths conservatively use 100vw. Preserve fill, contain, source, alt text, height, carousel and selection behavior.
rootCauses.tests: Six server-render tests use the real Next Image implementation, verify generated sizes/srcset for default, 3-column, full-width and flexible layouts plus a custom breakpoint, and retain afterSlide selection. Tests initially had a fixture syntax/type issue; these were corrected and the final suite passes.

rootCauses.name: Repeated selected-category UUID lookup
rootCauses.impact: Every category linearly searched the same selected-ID list. Larger selections spend measurable CPU on repeated membership checks; small lists have negligible costs and Set construction can be slightly slower.
rootCauses.fix: Build a Set once per filter call and reuse has for category IDs. Leave the separate per-category tag includes checks unchanged. Preserve tag/ID precedence, missing tag_reference behavior, any/all matching, output order, object references and duplicate selection semantics.
rootCauses.tests: Seven cases cover empty/default filters, duplicate and missing IDs, any/all tags, mixed ID/tag filters, and input/object preservation. Outputs match the previous function in measured workloads.

recipeReview: Fetched current recipes with no-cache curl and reviewed validation/false-positive criteria. Context identity verified at runtime, rather than merely moving the literal. Image import is next/image and sizes follow the actual grid/theme rules. UUID lookup Set is reused outside the loop; benchmarks include construction and approximate extra memory. Local Next image sizes documentation was read.
grouping: No fixGroupId on selected diagnostics. Category UUID membership is one repeated lookup root; two per-category tag lookup findings remain for separate workload review.

benchmark.method: Run actual before/after filterAllCategory functions transpiled from source. Five warmups and 25 timed calls; report median. Output equivalence asserted. Synthetic workloads, not production measurements. Approximate Set memory is GC-bracketed heap difference over 100 retained sets divided by 100 and is noisy.

validation.tests: 16 tests pass across 4 files, including existing checkout recovery coverage
validation.eslint: Zero errors; one pre-existing set-state-in-effect warning in ShopifySdkProvider cart cleanup remains untouched.
validation.overallCount: 106 to 76 across scans. Three source removals belong to this pass; 27 generated diagnostics also disappeared outside this work and are not claimed as fixes.
validation.limitations: No production build, real-browser image download measurement or live Shopify checkout. Context tests mock provider surfaces/SDK; image tests render actual Next Image on the server; benchmarks are synthetic.
